The trusted control constructs a complete proposal/current witness without calling an unavailable C0 social compiler/resolver. A generic O4 is insufficient: stage, actual cause and applicability evidence are mandatory. Missing source/seam evidence is BLOCKED.

A stage trace may expose a pure discarded candidate; it cannot justify partial durable/public publication. These are prospective obligations, not observed rollback results.
